sources.age: analysis/09 output/tables/feature_age_sex_rho.csv (partial rho, sex-adjusted; q<0.05 kept)
sources.population: analysis/09 output/tables/disease_univariate_v3.csv (rank-ANCOVA adjusted for age+sex, global BH FDR; q<0.05 kept)
sources.bp: analysis/09 output/tables/population_bp_association.csv (per-patient medians, rank partial age+sex, BH-FDR per source×target; q<0.05 kept; aurora a/o never pooled)

discipline: FORWARD description of labeled groups only — an elevated feature value must NEVER be reversed into a condition or symptom claim for the individual.  Effect sizes are small population shifts (|d| typically 0.1-0.3), not discriminators.  BP associations are weak population correlations (|rho| typically < 0.3) — NEVER use them to estimate an individual's blood pressure.  Individual differences are more often explained by measurement conditions, posture, perfusion, and physiology of the moment.

mechanism.label: Beat interval
mechanism.rationale: Beat interval is the inverse of heart rate; longer intervals correspond to slower rates. HR itself has no established monotonic relation with age here; interpreted only as cycle timing.

mechanism.label: Beat width ratio
mechanism.rationale: Beat width ratio quantifies pulse broadening, a stiffness-oriented trend; aurora shows the opposite age direction (see aurora_direction_flipped).

mechanism.label: Crest factor
mechanism.rationale: Crest factor (peak/rms) falls as the waveform flattens; a flat, broadened pulse is the classic stiffening morphology.

mechanism.label: Diastolic width (50%)
mechanism.rationale: Diastolic width tracks cycle timing; longer diastolic periods follow slower heart rates. aurora shows the reverse age trend.

mechanism.label: Diastolic width (75%)
mechanism.rationale: Same interpretation as DW50 at a higher threshold; aurora reverses.

mechanism.label: Dominant frequency #1
mechanism.rationale: Dominant spectral peak tracks heart rate; no independent vessel interpretation.

mechanism.label: Dominant frequency #2
mechanism.rationale: Secondary spectral peak; interpretation limited by HR coupling.

mechanism.label: Dominant frequency #3
mechanism.rationale: Tertiary spectral peak; weak signal, interpret with caution.

mechanism.label: Signal quality index
mechanism.rationale: Quality metric, not a physiology feature — rules never interpreted as vascular signal.

mechanism.label: Systolic/diastolic intensity ratio
mechanism.rationale: Ratio of systolic to diastolic intensity; direction with age is not established.

mechanism.label: Interquartile range
mechanism.rationale: Distribution spread of the waveform; a general morphology descriptor.

mechanism.label: Kurtosis
mechanism.rationale: Kurtosis falls as the waveform flattens (stiffening trend); aurora reverses.

mechanism.label: Large artery stiffness index
mechanism.rationale: Stiffness-oriented morphology proxy; age direction is source-dependent — vital/mimic decrease with age while aurora increases (see aurora_direction_flipped).

mechanism.label: Mean intensity
mechanism.rationale: Overall signal amplitude; largely a sensor/perfusion dependent scale, no vessel interpretation.

mechanism.label: Notch index (dn)
mechanism.rationale: Dicrotic notch prominence; shallower notch is the stiffening trend.

mechanism.label: Notch index (ip)
mechanism.rationale: Inflection-point prominence between systolic peak and notch.

mechanism.label: Normalized pulse volume
mechanism.rationale: Pulse volume normalized to the waveform; reflects perfusion more than vessel stiffness.

mechanism.label: Normalized notch time
mechanism.rationale: Notch timing normalized to the beat; weakly informative.

mechanism.label: Perfusion index
mechanism.rationale: Perfusion index is a clinical PPG metric; driven by vasomotor tone and sensor placement.

mechanism.label: PPG characteristic parameter
mechanism.rationale: Composite morphology parameter; aurora age direction is reversed vs vital.

mechanism.label: Pulse transit time
mechanism.rationale: Shorter PTT is often directionally associated with higher pressure or stiffness, but timing alignment and ECG/PPG quality matter.

mechanism.label: Pulse amplitude
mechanism.rationale: Pulse amplitude; dominated by measurement conditions, weak vessel interpretation.

mechanism.label: Pulse width (50%)
mechanism.rationale: Classic stiffening morphology (wider pulse); aurora reverses.

mechanism.label: Pulse width (90%)
mechanism.rationale: Same as PW50 at a higher threshold; aurora reverses.

mechanism.label: Reflection index
mechanism.rationale: Higher RI aligns with stronger reflected waves or peripheral vascular effects; age trend is weak and direction-inconsistent across sources (vital ~0, aurora slightly negative).

mechanism.label: Root mean square
mechanism.rationale: Waveform energy scale; aurora age direction is reversed vs vital.

mechanism.label: Feature-based signal quality index
mechanism.rationale: FSQI is used as a signal-quality context feature and should not be interpreted as a physiological diagnosis.

mechanism.label: Skewness
mechanism.rationale: Skewness of the waveform distribution; aurora age direction is reversed vs vital.

mechanism.label: Mean diastolic slope
mechanism.rationale: Diastolic decay slope; gentler decay accompanies stiffer arteries (vital/mimic).

mechanism.label: Normalized diastolic slope
mechanism.rationale: Normalized diastolic decay; the strongest age feature in step-06 selection.

mechanism.label: Systolic slope
mechanism.rationale: Systolic upstroke slope; a gentler rise accompanies stiffening (classic).

mechanism.label: Normalized systolic slope
mechanism.rationale: Normalized systolic upstroke; robust age signal in vital/mimic.

mechanism.label: Spectral centroid
mechanism.rationale: Spectrum centroid; falls with slower dominant rate. aurora reverses.

mechanism.label: Spectral entropy
mechanism.rationale: Spectrum flatness; no established vessel direction.

mechanism.label: Systolic width (50%)
mechanism.rationale: Systolic width at half height; broadening is the stiffening trend.

mechanism.label: Systolic width (75%)
mechanism.rationale: Same as SW50 at a higher threshold.

mechanism.label: Diastolic time
mechanism.rationale: Diastolic duration; lengthens as heart rate slows with age.

mechanism.label: Notch time
mechanism.rationale: Absolute notch time; mixed evidence, low specificity.

mechanism.label: Systolic time
mechanism.rationale: Systolic duration; lengthens modestly with age (selected in step-06 VAI).

mechanism.label: Wavelet entropy
mechanism.rationale: Multi-scale energy dispersion; no established vessel direction.
